meta.title: 存9️⃣个草原拍照动作！轻松拍出满满生命力😍
meta.title_en: Save These 9 Prairie Poses for Effortless Vitality
meta.topic: 拍照教学 · 草原姿势

scenes.context: 草原拍照动作。草原奔跑：侧身跑开，连拍抓帧；跳跃：起跳瞬间张开四肢，以空旷的草原为背景。语域：拍照教学，动作口令。
sentences: 草原奔跑，侧身跑开，连拍抓帧。
Run across the prairie sideways while the camera burst-fires.
burst-fires（连拍抓帧）
跳跃：起跳瞬间张开四肢。
For a jump, spread your limbs at the moment of takeoff.
spread your limbs（张开四肢）
空旷的草原，就是最好的背景。
An open prairie is the best background of all.
open prairie（空旷草原）
paraphrase: 连拍抓帧 → burst-fire / machine-gun the shutter
张开四肢 → spread your limbs / open wide
scenes.speak: Run across the prairie sideways while the camera burst-fires. For a jump, spread your limbs at the moment of takeoff. An open prairie is the best background of all.

scenes.context: 转身回眸：边走边回头，裙摆有动态；扬草：抓起一把草抛向天空，画面立刻生动。语域：拍照教学，动作口令。
sentences: 转身回眸：边走边回头，裙摆有动态。
Glance back mid-walk, letting the hem swing.
the hem swings（裙摆动）
扬草：抓起一把草，抛向天空。
Toss grass: grab a handful and fling it skyward.
fling it skyward（抛向天空）
动作一大，生命力就出来了。
The bigger the move, the more life the shot has.
the more life（越有生命力）
paraphrase: 回眸 → glance back / turn and look
扬草 → toss grass / fling grass up
scenes.speak: Glance back mid-walk, letting the hem swing. Toss grass: grab a handful and fling it skyward. The bigger the move, the more life the shot has.

scenes.title_en: Use the Wind and Open Your Arms
scenes.context: 借风：逆风站位，让风带起头发和裙摆；张开双臂迎风，拥抱草原的感觉。语域：拍照教学，动作口令。
sentences: 借风：逆风站位，风带起头发裙摆。
Use the wind: stand against it so it lifts your hair and hem.
stand against it（逆风站位）
张开双臂迎风，拥抱草原的感觉。
Open your arms into the wind, embracing the prairie.
embracing the prairie（拥抱草原）
逆光下，发丝都在发光。
Against the light, even your strands glow.
your strands glow（发丝发光）
paraphrase: 借风 → use the wind / work with the breeze
use the wind · work with breeze
拥抱草原 → embrace the prairie / take in the grassland
scenes.speak: Use the wind: stand against it so it lifts your hair and hem. Open your arms into the wind, embracing the prairie. Against the light, even your strands glow.

scenes.title_cn: 仰头大笑 + 席地而坐
scenes.title_en: Head-Back Laugh and Sitting on the Ground
scenes.context: 仰头大笑：露出牙齿，比微笑更有生命力；回眸/席地而坐：自然放松的动作。九个动作随便选，草原上怎么拍都好看。语域：拍照教学，收尾。
sentences: 仰头大笑：露出牙齿，比微笑更有生命力。
Laugh with your head back, teeth showing — more alive than a smile.
teeth showing（露出牙齿）
席地而坐，自然放松的动作。
Sit on the ground with naturally relaxed moves.
naturally relaxed（自然放松）
这九个动作，随便选都是大片。
Any of these nine poses can be a showstopper.
a showstopper（大片）
paraphrase: 仰头大笑 → laugh with head back / laugh skyward
大片 → a showstopper / a stunning shot
scenes.speak: Laugh with your head back, teeth showing — more alive than a smile. Sit on the ground with naturally relaxed moves. Any of these nine poses can be a showstopper.

practice: Run across the prairie sideways while the camera burst-fires.
Toss grass: grab a handful and fling it skyward.
Stand against the wind so it lifts your hair and hem.
Laugh with your head back, teeth showing — more alive than a smile.
pitfalls: Run and the camera takes pictures.
Run across the prairie while the camera burst-fires.
Spread your limbs at the moment of takeoff.
Grab a handful and fling it skyward.
Laugh with your head back, teeth showing.
「仰头大笑」用 laugh with your head back。
shifts: 用 burst-fires（连拍）、spread your limbs（张开四肢）、glance back（回眸）
用 the hem swings（裙摆飘动）、fling it skyward（抛向天空）、strands glow（发丝发光）
用 vitality（生命力）、showstopper（大片）、alive（灵动）
